_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: From the farthest places, God gathers us home.
Our mourning turns to dancing.
The Word became flesh and lived among us.
We have seen his glory.
From his fullness we have all received.
Grace upon grace.
Come, let us worship the God who gathers.
Glory to God. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: God is calling the scattered home from the ends of the earth — the blind, the lame, the new mother — a great crowd coming back together.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us.
He will turn your mourning into dancing, and your life will be like a watered garden, and you will never languish again.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us.
For the Word came and made his home with us, and from his fullness we have all received grace upon grace.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us.
Come in from wherever you have been; the God who scattered seed across the world is gathering it in.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us. Glory to God!
